description: Can follow scent trails over significant distance and age.
Detects subtle environmental change faster than typical for the species group.
Coordinates effectively with other predators; benefits from group tactics.
Sees in low-light conditions nearly as well as in daylight.
Coat or plumage breaks up its outline against natural terrain.
Unusually resistant to enchantment, illusion, and fear effects.
Notably more perceptive and deliberate than its species baseline.
Sustained aerial movement.
Moves effectively through water.
Moves effectively on vertical or broken terrain.
Tolerates cold wet conditions that would impair most working animals.
Tolerates high ambient temperatures without significant impairment.
Tolerates low ambient temperatures without significant impairment.
Handles smoke, ash, and airborne particulate without sensory impairment.
Can carry, push, or restrain loads disproportionate to body size.
Maintains pace over long distance better than species baseline.
Maintains flight over long distance better than species baseline.
Meaningfully longer lifespan than a mortal animal of its species.
Possesses a venom delivered via bite, sting, or other natural mechanism.
Actively adjusts appearance to match immediate surroundings.
Operates equally well in water and on land without penalty.
Moves with notably reduced sound for its size.
Detects nearby magical phenomena via instinctive awareness.
Remembers faces, scents, and commands of a bonded handler across unusual spans of time.
Maintains strong awareness of its claimed territory and intrusions within it.
